identificationModule.briefTitle: An Immuno-bridging Study of a Nonavalent HPV Vaccine (E.Coli) in Healthy Population Aged 9-17 vs Aged 18-26 Years Old
identificationModule.officialTitle: Immunogenicity Non-inferiority Immuno-bridging Study of a Recombinant Human Papillomavirus Nonavalent (Types 6,11,16,18,31,33,45,52,58) Vaccine (E.Coli) in Healthy Population Aged 9-17 Years Old vs Aged 18-26 Years Old

collaborators.name: Beijing Wantai Biological Pharmacy Enterprise Co., Ltd.

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a open label clinical trial to evaluate the safety and immunogenicity of a Recombinant Human Papillomavirus Nonavalent (Types 6,11,16,18,31,33,45,52,58)Vaccine(E.Coli) manufactured by Xiamen Innovax Biotech CO., Ltd., in healthy population aged 9-17 years old in comparison with aged 18-26.

armGroups.label: 9-17y (0,6m)
armGroups.description: Subjects who aged 9-17 years old would receive 2 doses of 270μg/0.5ml Recombinant HPV nonavalent (Types 6/11/16/18/31/33/45/52/58) Vaccine(E.Coli) .
interventionNames: Biological: 2 doses of theRecombinant Human Papillomavirus Nonavalent (Types 6,11,16,18,31,33,45,52,58 )Vaccine(E.Coli)

armGroups.label: 9-17y (0,1,6m)
armGroups.description: Subjects who aged 9-17 years old would receive 3 doses of 270μg/0.5ml Recombinant HPV nonavalent (Types 6/11/16/18/31/33/45/52/58) Vaccine(E.Coli) .
interventionNames: Biological: 3 doses of the Recombinant Human Papillomavirus Nonavalent (Types 6,11,16,18,31,33,45,52,58 )Vaccine(E.Coli)

armGroups.label: 18-26y (0,1,6m)
armGroups.description: Subjects who aged 18-26 years old would receive 3 doses of 270μg/0.5ml Recombinant HPV nonavalent (Types 6/11/16/18/31/33/45/52/58) Vaccine(E.Coli) .
interventionNames: Biological: 3 doses of the Recombinant Human Papillomavirus Nonavalent (Types 6,11,16,18,31,33,45,52,58 )Vaccine(E.Coli)

interventions.name: 3 doses of the Recombinant Human Papillomavirus Nonavalent (Types 6,11,16,18,31,33,45,52,58 )Vaccine(E.Coli)
interventions.description: Three doses administered intramuscularly at 0, 1 and 6 month.

interventions.name: 2 doses of theRecombinant Human Papillomavirus Nonavalent (Types 6,11,16,18,31,33,45,52,58 )Vaccine(E.Coli)
interventions.description: Two doses administered intramuscularly at 0 and 6 month.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Immunogenicity1: Anti-HPV 6, 11, 16, 18, 31, 33, 45, 52, and 58 type specific antibody levels at Months 7 in the population aged 9-26 years old receiving 3 doses of the nonavalent vaccine
primaryOutcomes.description: To determine whether the immune responses (antibodies to HPV-6, 11, 16, 18, 31, 33, 45, 52, and 58) at month 7 (one month after the final dose) in the population aged 9-17 years receiving 3 doses of the nonavalent vaccine are noninferior to those in women aged 18-26 years receiving 3 doses of vaccine.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Immunogenicity2: Anti-HPV 6, 11, 16, 18, 31, 33, 45, 52, and 58 type specific antibody levels at Months 7 in the population aged 9-14 years old receiving 2 doses of the nonavalent vaccine
secondaryOutcomes.description: To determine whether the immune responses (antibodies to HPV-6, 11, 16, 18, 31, 33, 45, 52, and 58) at month 7 (one month after the final dose) in the population aged 9-14 years receiving 2 doses of the nonavalent vaccine are noninferior to those in women aged 18-26 years receiving 3 doses of vaccine.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Immunogenicity3: Anti-HPV 6, 11, 16, 18, 31, 33, 45, 52, and 58 type specific antibody levels at months 18 and 30 in the population aged 9-14 and 15-17 years old receiving 2 doses or 3 doses of the nonavalent vaccine
secondaryOutcomes.description: To determine the immune persistence (antibodies to HPV-6, 11, 16, 18, 31, 33, 45, 52, and 58) at months 18 and 30 in the population receiving 2 doses or 3 doses of the nonavalent vaccine

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Safety1: Local and systematic adverse events/reactions occurred within 7 days after each vaccination.
secondaryOutcomes.description: Local and systematic adverse events/reactions occurred within 7 days after each vaccination.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: During the 7-day period following each vaccination

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Safety2: Adverse events/reactions occurred within 30 days after each vaccination.
secondaryOutcomes.description: Adverse events/reactions occurred within 30 days after each vaccination.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Safety3: Severe adverse events occurred throughout the study.
secondaryOutcomes.description: Severe adverse events occurred throughout the study. To evaluate number of SAEs between the different arms.
Pregnancy and pregnancy outcome. To evaluate number of births and terminations between the different arms.
